\caption{Waiting and the first action after a switch. (a)~Share of each S run's foreground time spent
waiting for ordinary summaries: dots are GLM runs, diamonds DeepSeek runs, bars GLM medians, and the dashed
line marks 10\%; one GLM S128 run ended before its first summary. (b)~Share of first actions that were
explicit read commands right after a switch (filled marks; small dots are single runs) and at a run's other
steps (open marks, from the fourth step after each switch). (c)~Same-state branches: change in the share
of read-only first proposed actions relative to S when the agent keeps the last two steps (K), or when
the two notices are removed (S-bare) or replaced with a continue instruction (S-cont); GLM branches come
from the replication (Section~\ref{sec:behavior}). Bars span the assignments of unclassified actions,
not sampling intervals.}
\label{fig:waiting-actions}
